scientific_question: Within the fixed post-open S2 six-direction family inherited from independently validated v52, can a fully pre-registered exact-gradient constrained multistart oracle find a complete frozen-v52 gate witness?

scope.directions: the same six fixed directions independently replayed in v52
scope.truth_constraints: the same exact affine-subspace field and coarse-gradient quadratic constraints used in v52

members_in_order: eight sealed-v52 requests selected by deterministic greedy farthest-point coverage
fixed_start_roster.farthest_point_rule: choose the request maximizing its minimum distance to all starts already selected
fixed_start_roster.score_usage: only the independently validated best index 2137 may depend on v52 scores; farthest-point selection reads weights and request indices only

optimizer.objective_gradient: one operator.forward builds the graph and torch.autograd.grad(loss, weights) supplies the exact six-vector gradient
all_objective_requests_record: start index and start-local request order

terminal_rescoring.budget_exhausted_terminal_definition: the last successfully evaluated point for that start, or the frozen start if no request completed
terminal_success_requirements_for_bounde: finite terminal weights, objective, gradient and constraints
weights inside the frozen box within constraint tolerance
both truth constraints at least minus constraint tolerance
KKT stationarity and complementarity gates pass

kkt_gate.multiplier_solver: scipy.optimize.nnls on active truth constraints and active lower/upper bounds
kkt_gate.normalized_stationarity_denominator: max(1.0, L2 norm of objective gradient)

formal_runner_budget.composition: 21F+3 reverse probes; at most 3072F+3072 reverse optimization; at most 12F+12 reverse terminal rescoring

complete_gate.within_1p01_of_direct_k4: field, gradient and observation relative-L2 ratios must all be <= 1.01
complete_gate.no_worse_than_zero: field, gradient and observation relative-L2 ratios must all be <= 1.0

decision_rules.robust_witness: gradient probes pass and at least one exact request passes the complete gate with minimum numeric margin at least 0.001
decision_rules.fragile_witness: gradient probes pass and at least one exact request passes the complete gate, but no passing request has minimum numeric margin at least 0.001
decision_rules.bounded_negative: gradient probes pass, no exact request passes the complete gate, and all 12 terminals satisfy every frozen success, feasibility and KKT requirement
decision_rules.inconclusive: gradient-probe failure, missing/invalid start execution, budget exhaustion without a positive witness, nonfinite value, failed terminal success/feasibility/KKT, source/input identity drift, seal drift or any execution-contract failure
decision_rules.positive_result_authorizes: design of a deployment-visible selector only after independent v53 validation

output_contract.output_location: new private directory outside the repository

required_future_independent_validation: do not import the v53 runner
independently bind and replay the full v52 evidence chain and v53 source/input closure
independently reconstruct all six fixed directions, truth constraints and start roster
replay every optimizer request in the same order with an independent exact VJP route
independently rerun all 12 SLSQP starts and terminal KKT checks
independently replay all gradient probes and central differences
verify START_ROSTER and runner report bytes remain unchanged
disclose that runner and validator still share the frozen curved-physics kernel

claim_boundary.a_robust_positive_result_would_show: representation headroom at one or more exact requests inside this fixed post-open S2 six-space, pending independent replay
claim_boundary.a_fragile_positive_result_would_show: numerically narrow representation headroom requiring a separately frozen robustness study
claim_boundary.a_bounded_negative_would_show: the fixed exact-gradient 12-start SLSQP contract found no complete-gate witness and every frozen terminal/probe validity gate passed
claim_boundary.a_bounded_negative_would_not_prove: continuous six-dimensional nonexistence, global optimality or mathematical impossibility
claim_boundary.historical_same_snapshot_observation_dep: v52 request 2137 is an explicitly post-open exploitation start
claim_boundary.shared_kernel_limitation: future runner and validator orchestration may be independent while sharing the same frozen curved-physics implementation
